title: CmdPal: Redesign the Performance Monitor GPU card

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The review candidate built successfully for x64 Debug and passed 147 of 147 unit tests. Earlier upstream validation is separate evidence. The candidate has not yet been proven equivalent to applying the literal public suggestions; final grounding and minimal-range checks remain in progress, so no executable suggestion is published. The final automated review targeted an older revision, and eight requests are exhausted without convergence. ARM64 and live GPU behavior remain unvalidated.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
